description.text: Purelake folk consider the kolgril very lucky. Eating one is said to ease aching joints for a month, and some claim it lets you read in the clouds when friends will come to visit.

items.text: One morning Ishikk caught a kolgril and gave it to Maib, who loved the fish for the aches in her fingers, so she would owe him and stop trying to coax him into marriage.
